severity.description: Default severity level for bug reports (e.g., normal, important, critical). Disabled by default in the shipped config.

bts.description: Bug Tracking System to use (e.g., debian, ubuntu).

submit.description: Submission address mode. Can be 'submit', 'quiet', or 'maintonly'.

mua.description: Mail User Agent to use (e.g., mutt, mh, nmh). Leave empty for internal mailer.

check_available.description: Boolean toggle. 'check-available' enables checking for newer releases, 'no-check-available' disables.

cc.description: Boolean toggle. 'cc' enables CCing the reporter, 'no-cc' disables.

config_files.description: Boolean toggle. 'config-files' enables including modified config files, 'no-config-files' disables.

compress.description: Boolean toggle. 'compress' enables stripping down config files, 'no-compress' disables.

sign_method.description: Method to digitally sign bug reports. Can be gpg, pgp, gnupg, or none.

keyid.description: GPG/PGP keyid to use for signing. Empty uses the default key on the system.

email.description: Default 'from' email address for bug reports.

realname.description: Default real name for bug reports.

smtphost.description: SMTP server hostname to use for sending reports via internal MTA.

smtphost_with_port.description: SMTP server with port (e.g., mail.example.com:2525). If smtphost is used, this is redundant but kept for completeness if port is specified separately.

smtptls.description: Boolean toggle. 'smtptls' enables TLS encryption via STARTTLS.

ui.description: User interface mode. Can be text, urwid, or gtk.

editor.description: Command to use as the text editor.

verify.description: Boolean toggle. 'verify' enables automatic package verification using debsums.

mode.description: Default operating mode. Can be novice, standard, advanced, or expert.

mbox_reader_cmd.description: Command to open the mbox file of reports.

justification.description: Default justification text for RC (Release Critical) bugs.

max_attachment_size.description: Maximum size allowed for an attachment file.

draftpath.description: Directory where unsubmitted reports are saved.
